subject: Connectivity roadmap: evaluation window and MSA sequencing
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medalign.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Connectivity roadmap & procurement alignment

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our engineering and procurement teams reviewed the POC notes and we want to align evaluation timing with procurement. High level asks: 

- Four-week technical eval (sandbox) starting late July.
- Legal (DPA) and MSA sequencing — procurement prefers signing the order form + MSA before prod provisioning.
- A way to get sandbox credentials earlier if legal redlines are purely administrative.

Can you send a short mutual action plan (MAP) with target dates and the minimum evidence you need for our legal team to complete DPA review? Our procurement lead (cc) is procurement@medalign.com.

Appreciate it —
Elena Cruz
Head of Platform Partnerships
MedAlign Health

Attachment: medalign_procurement_contacts.csv (csv stub)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medalign.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connectivity roadmap & procurement alignment

Hi Elena —

Great to hear this is moving forward. I put together a concise MAP + proposed sequencing attached (MAP_MedAlign_v1.xlsx). Key points here so we can move quickly: 

1) Eval window (sandbox): 2026-07-27 -> 2026-08-23 (4 weeks). Sandbox provisioning requires signed order form + sanitized data plan agreement (DPA) acknowledgement for access to telemetry.

2) Legal sequencing: run DPA review in parallel with MSA negotiation where possible. Our internal bar: if DPA redlines are limited to standard residency/audit clauses we can provision a sandbox under a short-term data handling addendum. If DPA redlines affect encryption/auditability, sandbox access waits until those are resolved.

3) Order form: needs purchase order number or committed billing contact to trigger provisioning. We can seed the sandbox with a dev quota (non-prod) once we have a signed order form and a named POC.

4) Owner & SLAs: recommend MedAlign assign a procurement owner and an engineering POC. On our side, Marcus will own sandbox provisioning and Laura will run acceptance criteria for the eval. Karthik is on legal for DPA/MSA.

Next asks from MedAlign:
- Confirm whether you will accept a short-term data addendum for sandbox access.
- Confirm procurement owner and target PO date (if you have an internal FY timing that constrains this).

I attached the MAP workbook and a suggested timeline. Happy to run a 30-min sync with procurement/legal this week.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions & GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_MedAlign_v1.xlsx (xlsx stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medalign.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connectivity roadmap & procurement alignment

Stephanie / team —

Quick legal note after scanning the MAP: we need to surface two items in the DPA redlines that will drive schedule:

1) Data residency / cross-border transfer clauses — MedAlign currently requires European residency for PHI-adjacent telemetry in some programs. If that is required for the sandbox telemetry, it adds time for our infra review.

2) Audit logs & retention — the draft DPA must include access to request audit exports and a minimum retention window; if they insist on >24 months we need to flag potential infra implications.

If MedAlign can accept a limited addendum that: (a) restricts sandbox telemetry to obfuscated identifiers and (b) adopts our standard 12-month retention for evaluation telemetry, we can complete DPA sign-off in ~7-10 business days.

I attached an annotated redline with the above proposals. If they accept, we’ll push the sandbox provisioning owner (Marcus) to enable dev keys ASAP.

-Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_redlines_steph_v1.docx (docx stub)
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@medalign.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medalign.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Connectivity roadmap & procurement alignment

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear MAP and timeline. Procurement is comfortable with the high-level plan. A couple of clarifications: 

- We can accept an obfuscated-telemetry addendum for sandbox, provided the MSA/DPA include a clear rollback path.
- Our procurement owner is Mark DuVal (mark.duval@medalign.com) — he is copied on the internal thread (procurement@medalign.com).
- Target PO date: 2026-08-05 (tentative) — we have an internal budget checkpoint the week of 8/2 that will confirm.

If Karthik’s proposed DPA redlines are acceptable we’ll sign the addendum and share an executed PO. Is it possible to provision a constrained sandbox the week of 8/2 if redlines are narrow? That would help our engineers start smoke tests before the main eval window.

Thanks —
Elena

Team —

Summarizing internal next steps so we have a single owner list and dates (for HubSpot and the MAP):

- Legal (Karthik): finalize DPA addendum redline and send to Elena by EOD Mon 7/6.
- Solutions (Marcus): prep constrained sandbox plan (network ACLs, obfuscated telemetry flag) and estimate provisioning time (target: 2 business days after signed addendum).
- GTM (Stephanie): schedule 30-min sync with MedAlign procurement + engineering; propose Mon 7/6 or Tue 7/7.
- CS (Laura): define acceptance checklist for canonical smoke tests during 7/27–8/23 eval window; I will produce the checklist by Tue 7/7.

Operational notes to include in the MAP workbook before we send to MedAlign: owner names, target PO date 2026-08-05, HubSpot record id D-9841, DocuSign placeholder (see link), and the three attachments we referenced.

I’ll update the MAP workbook and upload the final MAP to the HubSpot record once Karthik confirms redlines.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
